title: Dropping new game ideas here weekly where I'm focusing on finding the fun. Week 3: All Lit Up
author: StaticAnchor
selftext:
After a brief hiatus, I'm back to drop a new prototype called All Lit Up.

Rules are simple.   
  
You have 5 pucks. Flick them onto the board and light up enough tiles and gain enough points to move on to the next round. Be careful, the more you light up a tile the more points you earn, but over time it will break.

Use the shop in between rounds to upgrade your pucks and tiles.

9 rounds. Can you beat the machine?

My philosophy is to find a simple mechanic that's fun and build around that. It's been awesome to find moments that make yourself smile. I'm trying to lean into that.

Any feedback is alway appreciated, hope you enjoy it!

Play it for free on itch today: [All Lit Up](https://hookandsinkergames.itch.io/all-lit-up)
